title: Whole Earth Catalog page 187: 15th-century Scandinavian 'Witch Rider' tale
place_text: Soap Plant bookstore, Melrose, Los Angeles; Scandinavia

tellings.quote: And I find this book of outof print uh ghost stories from Scandinavia in the 15th century.

plain: In the Soap Plant bookstore on Melrose in Los Angeles, the screenwriter Brent Friedman says he found an out-of-print book of 15th-century Scandinavian ghost stories, among them a tale called "Witch Rider." Friedman tells it first-hand and ties the find to page 187 of the Whole Earth Catalog, a well-known catalogue of books and tools. He tells it as one of the strange finds behind his work in Hollywood.
